description.value: The Best Western Plus Chemainus Inn is an award-winning suite-style hotel situated in the artsy Vancouver Island town of Chemainus, celebrated for its outdoor mural trail and live theatre. It sits roughly midway between Victoria and Nanaimo on the Island Highway corridor, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the east coast of Vancouver Island. Complimentary hot breakfast is included with every stay.
